usedFor: invoicexpress issues invoices, with “Create Client” and “Create new Invoice” setting up billing for each customer.

bestTemplate.name: “Create new Invoice” in invoicexpress
bestTemplate.why: It creates the invoice itself, and “Finalize Invoice-Receipt” can then close it.

watchOut: “Delete Item” deletes items from invoicexpress, so check which item it targets before it runs.
